queries: Gemini 350 million monthly active users March 2025 court documents daily active users
Google cost per AI query serving cost reduced Gemini profitable per query Pichai

sources_considered.why: Reports Gemini user counts from a court exhibit in the Google antitrust case, including October 2024, which is inside the target period.
Pichai on falling per-query AI cost. Context only: it gives no cost-versus-revenue figure and dates from May 2025.
National survey from August 2024 ranking Gemini second among generative AI products. Context, since it falls just before the target period.
About ad revenue parity for AI Overviews, not cost per prompt. Not read in full.

receipt.public_excerpt: in October 2024, Gemini’s user numbers were 9 million daily and 90 million monthly.

evidence_items.explanation: About 90 million monthly users in October 2024 is a sizeable absolute audience. That cuts against a literal 'nobody cares', though not against the relative reading. Reported from a court exhibit.

receipt.public_excerpt: Meta AI was nearing 500 million monthly users as of September 2024, while OpenAI recently said that its weekly active users top 400 million.

evidence_items.explanation: Rivals had several times Gemini's audience around the target period. That supports the relative reading that Gemini uptake was weak given Google's reach.

receipt.public_excerpt: “We’ve seen for a given query the cost has fallen dramatically in the [past] 18-month time frame.”

evidence_items.explanation: Pichai says per-query cost fell sharply but gives no cost or revenue figures. It neither confirms nor refutes per-prompt losses.

receipt.public_excerpt: The most commonly used product was ChatGPT (28 percent) followed by Google Gemini (16 percent).

evidence_items.explanation: In a US survey from August 2024, just before the target period, Gemini was the second most used generative AI product. That suggests real if secondary interest.

unresolved_gaps: Google does not disclose per-prompt serving cost or revenue for Gemini, the API, Workspace, or AI Overviews, so the 'losing money on every prompt' part cannot be checked with public data.
No agreed benchmark says how many users counts as 'caring' relative to Google's scale.
